verdict.rationale: Evidence shows AI code review, AI-triggered pipeline workflows, and Rovo access in terminal/IDE, but nothing indicates Bitbucket itself can be operated via natural-language commands (e.g., chat-based repo management, NL-driven PR/merge actions). Missing for 10: any documentation of natural-language command interface, conversational control of Bitbucket actions, or hands-on evidence of NL-driven operation.
